newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly higher in quiet trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished slightly higher against its U.S. counterpart on Moday on a lack of fresh news in the market, dealers said.
The local rate ended at T$27.487 against Saturday's T$27.491. Turnover was US$172 million.

"The market is very dull," said one dealer at a foreign bank. "There is no inspiration for trading and it doesn't look like the situation will end soon." Quiet overseas markets also pushed some players to the sidelines, dealers noted.
A T$27.480-520 trading range was seen in coming sessions. -- Joyce Liu (2-5080815)
